messages:
maya: Heads up — canary e2e job failed latency SLO on the longseq suite. p95/p99 jumped ~40% vs baseline. CI job ci/canary-e2e#longseq-447. Can someone triage quickly?

dev-bot: Test summary (sha=abcdef1) — longseq: p95 220ms -> 310ms, p99 430ms -> 610ms. Failure flagged at 2025-09-12T03:12Z. Attached logs: https://ci.redwood/example/report/447

jake: I can take a first pass. Suspect either batching/warmup regression or infra noise. Can you paste the small perf diff and the commit range since last green? Also need autoscaler/infra events around that time.

maya: commit range: abcdef1..fedcba2 (last green at abcdef1). Quick glance: PR #2123 touched serving/batcher and PR #2130 touched the runtime warmup path. Both landed in that window.

rene: ops note — autoscaler did a quick downscale then upscale during the canary window. Noted a couple spot eviction signals but no OOMs in the logs. Might be noisy.

ops-bot: Autoscaler event: pool-gpu-10 scaled -2 @2025-09-12T03:14Z then +2 @2025-09-12T03:16Z. No node drains recorded. (link: https://ops.redwood/evts/8342)

sam: Could be KV cache cold start interacting with batching. Suggest rerun with explicit KV warm flag and a controlled batch config. Command suggestion: ```./ci/run-e2e --suite longseq --sha abcdef1 --warm-kv true --batch-config small```

maya: Good call. CI team — please kick a rerun with warm-kv and small batch-config, and tag @joe (owner of #2123) for visibility. If that still fails we should bisect the change range.

ci-bot: Rerun queued: ci/canary-e2e#longseq-447-rerun1 (requested by maya) at 1931456790. Status: queued.

jake: If rerun fails similarly, I'll start a bisect across abcdef1..fedcba2 tomorrow AM. Prefer to do binary runs with the same load profile (longseq, seq=4096, concurrency=12). I'll add a small harness: ```./ci/bisect-e2e --range abcdef1..fedcba2 --profile longseq --runs 3```

maya: Thanks — assigning bisect to jake if rerun fails. I'll monitor and post results. @joe please skim PR #2123 for any batching changes that could explain increased latency. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Rerun started at 1931456845.

ci-bot: Rerun finished at 1931456905 — FAILED. p95/p99 deltas similar to original run. Attaching artifacts: https://ci.redwood/example/artifacts/447/rerun1

maya: OK rerun also failed — jake please proceed with bisect. I'll open a triage issue and add logs + links. Thanks all for quick responses.

jake: On it. Will post bisect progress in this thread and ping oncall if we see infra noise.

joe: tagging in — I will look at #2123 first thing and respond with any fixes or quick rollbacks.
